about_short_description.short_description: Polymath Robotics is a plug-and-play software designed to automate industrial vehicles that are operating in closed environments.

product.name: Coverage Mapper
product.description: A module that generates coverage paths within defined polygonal boundaries for off-highway vehicles to methodically cover an area, accounting for obstacles and vehicle turning radius.

product.name: Behavior Control
product.description: An API-driven module that allows programming of specific, repetitive vehicle behaviors based on location or task requirements for off-highway vehicles.

product.name: Lidar Fusion
product.description: A module that processes raw Lidar data to produce clean, usable point clouds by filtering noise, calibrating multiple sensors, and enhancing data quality for autonomous navigation.
